acceptance: Crate aipo-ir implemented with target-neutral Core IR data structures and lowering from HIR+sema.
Crate aipo-bytecode implemented with instruction set, constant pool, binary module format (AIBC v1), bytecode emitter, structural verifier, and disassembler.
Bytecode verifier guarantees stack effect and valid jump target invariants before load.
Disassembler produces deterministic text listings for snapshots.
Round-trip emit -> verify -> disassemble tests pass.
Zero unsafe code (unsafe_code = 'forbid') and all quality gates green.
constraints: Bytecode verifier strictly rejects malformed modules and invalid jump offsets.

evidence.description: cargo test -p aipo-ir -p aipo-bytecode passed with 6 automated tests covering Core IR lowering, bytecode emission, opcode execution invariants, AIBC binary format verification, and disassembly listing

non_goals: VM execution engine or runtime GC (reserved for Wave 1 Slice S7 aipo-vm).
objective: Implement aipo-ir and aipo-bytecode with target-neutral Core IR, compact bytecode module, verifier, and disassembler
title: Core IR & Bytecode: Lowering, instruction encoding, verifier, and disassembler
